basis.method: Review of retained candidate evidence, archived factual reviews and source context; no new collection and no production write.

families.finding: Official flavour-specific panels declare 21 g, 21.5 g or 22 g servings while the tracked active doses remain the same.

families.product_name: Dorian Yates Blood & Guts Pre Workout 380g
families.finding: Variants 764-770 deliberately preserve conflicting caffeine information from the common source. Variant 1579 has a separate flavour-specific declaration of 372 mg total caffeine and a slightly different citrulline amount.
families.action: Retain current explicit states and flavour-specific facts.

families.finding: Official flavour-specific panels declare 13.5 g, 17 g or 17.5 g servings while the tracked active doses remain the same.

The sources describe the same formula on two valid bases: one scoop/10.5 g with 200 mg caffeine and 1600 mg beta-alanine, and an advanced two-scoop/21 g serving with doubled amounts. Current variants mix those bases.
families.recommended_decision: Use one scoop/10.5 g as the catalogue basis because the 420 g product is presented as 40 one-scoop servings; preserve the two-scoop dose only as source context.
families.action: Do not change production until the serving-basis decision is approved.

families.finding: The manufacturer presents one scoop/7 g and two scoops/14 g. Current variants mix 200 mg and 400 mg caffeine bases even though the catalogue identity says 60 servings.
families.recommended_decision: Use one scoop/7 g as the catalogue basis for the 60-serving identity; preserve the two-scoop dose only as source context.
families.action: Do not change production until the serving-basis decision is approved.

families.product_name: RAW Nutrition Essential BUM Pre-Workout 30 servings
families.finding: Separate official flavour tables declare 14.1 g and 13.1 g servings with the same tracked active doses.

families.product_name: Trained By JP DNFM PRE 40 Servings
families.finding: Retained evidence scopes an 8 g/200 mg caffeine presentation to older retailer flavours and a 16 g/400 mg presentation to a manufacturer group of newer flavours. This may be a deliberate flavour or generation split, but it is not safe to standardise without exact generation evidence.
families.action: Obtain or identify exact labels tying each older and newer flavour group to its formula generation.

families.finding: Two retained retailer source sets bind named flavours to different beta-alanine declarations, 500 mg and 935 mg, while serving and other tracked facts agree. The difference may reflect formula generation or flavour-specific tables.
families.action: Require exact label or generation evidence before changing either group.

families.product_name: Cellucor C4 Original Pre-Workout Powder 30 Servings
families.finding: Retained contexts distinguish 195 g/6.5 g and 204 g/6.8 g pack and serving presentations while tracked active amounts agree.
families.action: Retain current facts and pack-specific serving weights.

families.finding: Manufacturer evidence declares 16.1 g and 6000 mg citrulline malate for two flavours; retailer evidence declares 16.5 g and 6000 mg L-citrulline for two other flavours. The form difference is material and may indicate separate formula generations.
families.action: Require exact label or manufacturer generation evidence for variants 3718 and 3719 before changing facts.

families.finding: Variant 3855 contains only a supported present-without-disclosed-amount caffeine fact; variant 3856 has additional supported facts. This is evidence completeness, not a contradictory transcription.
families.action: Retain current facts until stronger evidence for variant 3855 is available.

high_caffeine_review.product_name: Gas Mark 10 No Games Pre Workout 30 Servings
high_caffeine_review.finding: The retained complete formula and common flavour context explicitly declare a 20 g serving and 600 mg caffeine. The value is unusually high but is not a transcription of the 600 g pack size.
high_caffeine_review.action: Retain 600 mg; do not convert the unusual dose into an automatic error.

pending_correction.note: The separate Stim Thug correction requires its own controlled production authorization.

next_step: Obtain one owner serving-basis decision for products 62 and 763, then prepare only the resulting correction candidates. Continue evidence review for products 878, 1162 and 1249 without changing production facts until exact formula-generation evidence is available.
